text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the bus to summer camp, I can't help but feel nervous about the upcoming race against Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright assures me it'll be fine, but we don't have a solid plan for how to compete against her unnatural speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To face off against an opponent as incredible as Silence Suzuka, we'll need to rely on the collective knowledge of the Mejiro family.
